Authentic and Family Friendly Dining Place
Sep 2026 • Family
From the moment we arrived at Viet Kitchen, Renaissance Riverside Saigon, Thuy, the Navigator, and the entire team welcomed our family with exceptional warmth and genuine Vietnamese hospitality. During our stay from 28 August to 4 September 2026, they made us feel completely at home, taking special care to ensure our young child was comfortable, happy, and warmly included.

The authentic Vietnamese cuisine was a true highlight. The selection was excellent, and the Vietnamese station offered vibrant local flavours that brought the dining experience to life. We especially enjoyed the steaming pho and rich, aromatic Vietnamese coffee—both delicious, satisfying, and wonderfully authentic.

What made our experience truly memorable was the heartfelt service from every member of the team. Their friendly smiles, thoughtful attention, and sincere care created a relaxed and welcoming atmosphere for our family throughout our stay.

We will certainly return to Renaissance Riverside Hotel on our next visit to Ho Chi Minh City.

The World’s 1st Four Michelin Star Restaurant in the making?
Jul 2023 • Solo
I know, I know, readers may think I am nuts.
Viet Kitchen (VK) is that good. If I were in control of the Michelin Star rating system, I would create a Four Michelin Star category just for VK.
Went there for lunch today as am currently staying in Renaissance Saigon, had little time on my hands and confronted by a gloomy sky.
Staff attentive from the start where I am greeted with sincerity, brought to my table and with the presentation of the menu, useful suggestions and recommendations followed after Ngo Tran Kim (VK’s Manager) was informed of my preferences, etc.
As a food taster myself for a few well-known restaurants years back, I know the best test for any restaurant is to sample its simple and local dishes.
I went for the Pho Bo and Peach Crunch Smoothie (spinach was also an ingredient in this smoothie).
The latter was presented first and tasted nothing less than perfect. No grassy texture nor after-taste and a light touch of sweetness from the peach. Not overdone nor underwhelming in overall taste and intensity. Perfect as a perk-me-up before main course.
Then came the Pho Bo which has rich “bone-based” soup which is a perfect balance of marrow-induced, savory and meatiness flavor. Soup not too think nor too watery. It runs well down my throat, making me thirst for more….
Beef is cooked to my specs, rare and rice noodles not soggy nor stale.
Overall a simple, hearty, local South Vietnamese main dish.
There are also 4 set menus for busy people to grab a quick lunch and main menu looks so inviting as well….the snapper fish & chips, the Viet spring rolls, etc.
Yikes! There is a small pool of drool on my bedsheet now!
Some people are addicted to love and some are addicted to adult drinks.
But I am now addicted to Viet Kitchen!
